verdict.rationale: The only time-to-onboard signal is a marketing claim that Instant Pay offers "full integration in under a sprint" with SDKs and webhooks. Supporting claims cover instant virtual card creation and inviting 1 to 1,000+ team members with custom roles. Nothing documents how long account opening, KYC/KYB approval or full platform activation takes. Missing for 10: documented account-opening/KYB timeline, an end-to-end onboarding process description, independent or hands-on confirmation of a roughly one-week onboarding, and evidence that the speed claim covers the whole banking platform rather than just the payments API integration.
